facts.text: South Africa recorded 49 mining fatalities in 2022, the lowest on record, compared with 74 in 2021.
facts.quote: In 2022 there were 49 mining fatalities, the lowest on record (74 in 2021).

facts.text: South Africa's mining fatality statistics define the "transport and mining" category as rail-bound equipment, trackless mobile machinery and winches.
facts.quote: The "transport and mining" category (rail-bound equipment, trackless mobile machinery and winches)

facts.text: The "transport and mining" category was the largest category of South African mining fatalities in 2022, with 17 deaths, up from 16 in 2021.
facts.quote: was the largest with 17 deaths, up from 16 in 2021

facts.text: South Africa recorded no mining fatalities in the "machinery" category in 2022, compared with three in 2021.
facts.quote: no "machinery" fatalities were recorded in 2022 against three in 2021

facts.text: The Mine Health and Safety Council reported that trackless mobile machinery accounted for 17% of South African mining fatalities from January to June 2019 and ranked third among fatality causes.
facts.quote: The Mine Health and Safety Council reported trackless mobile machinery (TMM) at 17% of fatalities in January to June 2019, third after falls of ground (43%)

facts.text: The Mine Health and Safety Council reported that falls of ground accounted for 43% of South African mining fatalities from January to June 2019.
facts.quote: in January to June 2019, third after falls of ground (43%)

facts.text: South Africa recorded 42 mining fatalities in 2024, compared with 55 in 2023.
facts.quote: In 2024 South Africa recorded 42 mining fatalities (55 in 2023).

facts.text: The Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources reported 14 South African mining deaths in the "transportation and mining" category in 2024, about one third of total mining fatalities.
facts.quote: The Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources reported 14 deaths in its "transportation and mining" category, about one third of the total

entities.name: Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources

facts.text: South Africa's "transportation and mining" fatality category included nine trackless mobile machinery-related fatalities in 2024, up from six in 2023.
facts.quote: including nine TMM-related fatalities, up from six the year before

facts.text: Published scenario detail is insufficient to determine how many of South Africa's nine trackless mobile machinery-related fatalities in 2024 would have been preventable by object-detection automatic braking.
facts.quote: Published scenario detail is not sufficient to say how many of the nine would have been preventable by object-detection automatic braking.

facts.text: A trade article attributes to the Minerals Council the statement that South Africa recorded "only one TMM collision-related death" in 2022.
facts.quote: A trade article attributes to the Minerals Council the statement that "only one TMM collision-related death" was recorded in 2022

facts.text: A trade article credits wider use of collision avoidance for South Africa's reported single trackless mobile machinery collision-related death in 2022.
facts.quote: "only one TMM collision-related death" was recorded in 2022 and credits wider use of collision avoidance

facts.text: The claim of only one South African trackless mobile machinery collision-related death in 2022 is not contradicted by the official figure of 17 deaths, because the official figure covers the whole transport-and-mining category rather than TMM collisions alone.
facts.quote: Because the 17 deaths in 2022 are the whole transport-and-mining category, not TMM collisions alone, this claim is not contradicted by the official figures

facts.text: The trade article's claim that South Africa recorded only one trackless mobile machinery collision-related death in 2022 could not be verified in a primary source.
facts.quote: but it could not be verified in a primary source.
